## Drain and Sewer Problems

- Floor drain backing up
- Sewage backing up through a floor drain
- Floor drain backing up when a washing machine drains
- Basement floor drain backup
- Multiple fixtures backing up together
- Main sewer line blockage
- Toilet, sink, bathtub, or shower drain backups
- Sewer line restrictions caused by roots, buildup, or other problems

## Important Service Information

A floor drain backup does not always mean the floor drain itself is blocked. The restriction can be farther down a branch drain, shared drain line, or main sewer line.

A washing machine sends a large amount of water into the drain line quickly. If the floor drain rises when the washer drains, the washer may be exposing a restriction farther downstream.

Homes without basements can show a main-line backup differently. When a main line is completely stopped, wastewater may rise into a bathtub or shower instead of a basement floor drain.

A-1 Drain Cleaning serves Mason City and North Iowa and provides 24/7 drain cleaning and sewer service.
